rightsS1Text: This page sets out the rules for using the materials on the Ungarov Academy website (hereinafter, the “Academy”). By using the website, you agree to these terms.
rightsS2Text: The Academy operates in the following areas:
rightsS2Item1: Courses: educational courses in IT and foreign languages. New areas, including SMM, targeting and mobile photography and videography courses, are planned for the future.
rightsS2Item2: Consulting services: document translation and assistance with submitting applications to universities in Saudi Arabia.
rightsS2Item3: Agency services: developing websites and software solutions for clients. The Academy team assists with organizing projects.
rightsS2Outro: The list of services and their terms may change over time. Up-to-date information is published on the relevant pages.
rightsS3Text: All content on the website, including course programs, learning materials, texts, assignments, graphic and design elements, the logo, the name and the source code, belongs to the Academy or its partners and is protected by applicable law. Rights to the materials are not transferred to any other person without the Academy's written consent.
rightsS4Text: The website materials may be used only for personal, non-commercial educational purposes. When quoting, the Academy's name and a link to the website must be given as the source.
rightsS5Text: Without the Academy's written consent, the following are prohibited:
rightsS5Item1: copying, distributing, selling or posting the materials, in whole or in part, on other platforms;
rightsS5Item2: creating a course or educational product in your own name based on the course materials;
rightsS5Item3: using the website design, logo or name as your own;
rightsS5Item4: collecting the website content by automated means (bots, scraping) or interfering with its operation.
rightsS6Text: Personal documents provided as part of consulting services (passport, diploma, certificate and others) are used only for translation, submission and organization purposes and are not disclosed to third parties, except for the universities or organizations required for the service. The procedure for processing personal data is described in a separate privacy policy.
rightsS7Text: The names and marks of universities, programs and organizations belong to their respective owners. They are used only to explain the content of our services and do not mean that we are their official representative.
rightsS8Text: The final decision on university admission, placement in a program and visa matters is made by the relevant university and government authorities. The Academy helps prepare and submit documents correctly, but does not guarantee the admission result.
rightsS9Text: The website may contain links to third-party websites. The Academy is not responsible for their content or privacy policies.
rightsS10Text: The Academy strives to ensure the accuracy and relevance of the website materials but does not guarantee that they are completely error-free. The website is provided “as is”. The Academy shall not be liable, to the extent permitted by law, for damages resulting from technical interruptions or misuse of the information.
rightsS11Text: If any material on the website infringes your copyright, write to {email}. In your message, include a link to the material and information confirming your rights. Your request will be reviewed and, if necessary, the material will be removed.
rightsS12Title: Changes to the terms and governing law
rightsS12Text: The Academy may update these terms at any time. The current version is published on this page. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
